interaction.name: Multiple Choice
interaction.title: What is the overall objective of System Wide Information Management (SWIM)?

responses.response: To provide information users with relevant and commonly understandable information of the right quality, provided at the right time and delivered to the right place, so enabling the concept of net-centric ATM operations
To provide information users with relevant and commonly understandable information and enabling all to have access to aviation information
Streamlining and volume reduction of unnecessary information to enable the provision of all global aviation information to users

interaction.title: Which of these statements correctly defines the scope of ADQ?

responses.response: Eu-Reg. 73/2010 (ADQ) deals with all upstream data & information handling activities (both systematic and procedural), from origination to publication
Eu-Reg. 73/2010 (ADQ) deals with all downstream data & information handling activities (both systematic and procedural), from publication through to end use
